criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Dark staged register on every frame, slide 5 a showstopper candidate with exact counts, slides 1 and 4 strong. Slide 2 a flat card, slide 6's flags rigid planks, slide 3's panels out of line with the louvres, slide 7 corrugated.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lastLight world, one key, one accent meaning, a dusk to night arc. Slide 2 sits outside, the fence motif faint.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every figure traces and every drawn count matches its unit. Looser: Phase 1 joined to the 50 MW by matching MW and site, slide 5's headline, c1's date and c22's placement from claim text, the cover's past tense, no 8-K.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, where and the condition are clear. No deciding body and no date, the grid draw stated without consequence.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The turn sits at 5 and 6 follows, the link left soft. Three frames about the land.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and specific, Drawn to illustrate on eight deks, no Caprock texture in the copy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The tower-section unit and road camera are fresh, lastLight and the stake row and squares line repeat.

one_sentence_fix: Fetch the Commissioners Court's calendar and the county's abatement guidelines so the close names the body and the next date.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat mottled card with a 27 px square.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A 35 degree oblique showing a lit cliff and its cast, the plateau two thirds of the frame, raised neighbours.
Cloth ribbons tied at the stake top, the nearest stake a third of the frame tall with a cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Panels out of line with the louvres, the pole line invisible.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Glow behind the louvre blades, a lit pole line.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Corrugated siding and streaking post casts.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower ridges, straw patches in the L, shorter edge casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A heap of rings and a doubled post.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Linked chain through both stiles, one gate post.
